# A cookie parameter is not sent: the operation is left out.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

! sngl check app.sngl
stderr 'import "openapi:./api.yml": GET /thing is left out: parameter session is in the cookie, and only a path.s and a query.s are sent'
stderr 'app.sngl:4:16: unknown component'

-- app.sngl --
import api "openapi:./api.yml"

func ask() {
    var r = api.getThingCall()
}
-- api.yml --
openapi: 3.1.0
info: {title: T, version: "1"}
servers:
- url: https://api.example
paths:
  /thing:
    get:
      operationId: getThing
      parameters:
      - {name: session, in: cookie, schema: {type: string}}
      responses:
        '200': {description: '', content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}
